description: At a fountain in an old town square in autumn, a male mallard duck with a glossy green head, a white neck ring and orange feet flies in with its wings spread wide and lands on the arm of a white stone statue of a man in a robe. It folds its wings and sits there, looking around. A brown female duck swims in the water below, another green-headed male floats on the right, water spouts from carved stone fish, pigeons walk on the paving, and a church tower and a bakery stand behind.
